fields_appended.name: repricing_final_rate_schedule
fields_appended.unit: annual rate as a decimal fraction
fields_appended.description: Pairs YYYY-MM-DD,rate separated by ASCII spaces. The value is the final contractual rate before cap/floor; conflicting rates on one date are invalid.

rules: V1 keeps its legacy semantics. V2 requires the explicit contractual-v2 policy for nonempty extension fields.
FLOAT v1 explicit rate components are ambiguous under CONTRACTUAL_V2 and are rejected.
An explicit final rate supersedes ordinary repricing on the same date. The next ordinary reset uses the original spread plus the indicator.
Nonempty source indicator_lag_cd is quarantined under V2 until its code is documented.
